observations.body: Comfort moves through affliction toward others. Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
